events.title: Vauxhall Pleasure Gardens open in London
events.description: Lit walks, music and spectacle for a paying public — an early ancestor of the theme park.

events.title: Russian Mountains, St Petersburg
events.description: Wheeled carts on wooden tracks turn winter ice slides into a year-round gravity ride.

events.title: Promenades Aériennes, Paris
events.description: Tracked cars with wheels locked to the rails — a recognisable coaster.

events.title: Tivoli Gardens open in Copenhagen
events.description: A garden of rides, lights and music that still operates today.

events.title: Pepper's Ghost debuts in London
events.description: John Henry Pepper popularises Henry Dircks' glass-reflection illusion at the Royal Polytechnic.

events.title: Switchback Railway, Coney Island
events.description: LaMarcus Thompson's gravity ride charges a nickel and pays for itself in weeks.

events.title: Disneyland opens in Anaheim
events.description: A single-entrance, hub-and-spoke park built around themed lands and a central castle.

events.title: Matterhorn Bobsleds — first tubular steel coaster
events.description: Steel tube track makes smooth, precise curves possible.

events.title: Great American Revolution — modern vertical loop
events.description: Werner Stengel's clothoid loop keeps g-forces survivable and makes the loop a staple.

events.title: ASTM Committee F24 formed
events.description: Industry, operators and regulators begin writing shared amusement ride standards.

events.title: The peak-end rule is described
events.description: Kahneman and colleagues show people remember peaks and endings, not durations.

events.title: Flight of Fear — first LIM-launched coaster
events.description: Linear induction motors launch a train from a standstill inside a building.

events.title: Virtual queueing goes mainstream
events.description: Paper return tickets let guests wait somewhere else — changing how waits feel.

events.title: Machine-learned wait-time predictions in park apps
events.description: Operators publish forecasts, not just posted waits, using historical and live data.
